scope: Research-only batch of newly discovered, semantically screened public karaoke-medley candidates. No production medley assignment is modified by this manifest.

entries.title: Sa Aking Puso
entries.note: Known-good control passed 3 independent sustained-playback runs.

entries.title: Rivermaya Medley (Karaoke HQ Version)
entries.evidence: Public YouTube description lists Elesi, Ulan, Kissapmata, Hinahanap-Hanap Kita, Himala, and 214. Public video result snapshot reported 13,203,616 views. Karaoke cover is stated by uploader; audio/presentation remains unreviewed.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.006 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 5 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: April Boy Regino Medley (HQ Karaoke Version with Lyrics)
entries.evidence: Public YouTube page identifies a karaoke version with lyrics and reports 16,021,148 views. Description says instruments were manually programmed by the channel. Exact section list and audio/presentation remain unreviewed.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.006 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 6 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: Renz Verano Medley (Karaoke)
entries.evidence: Public YouTube description lists Ibang Iba Ka Na, Remember Me, and You and I; it claims smooth transitions and clear lyrics. Those production claims are uploader statements, not independent quality verification.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.006 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 5 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: 2006 OPM Hits Medley Karaoke
entries.evidence: Public YouTube page identifies a multi-song OPM karaoke medley and reports 1,276,388 views. Its description links a lyric video but does not list medley sections.

entries.title: 2005 OPM Hits Medley Karaoke
entries.evidence: Public YouTube page identifies a multi-song OPM karaoke medley and reports 996,835 views. Its description links a lyric video but does not list medley sections.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.006 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 5 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: Pangako, Maging Sino Ka Man, Kung Kailangan Mo Ako — Rey Valera Medley
entries.evidence: Public YouTube description lists Pangako, Kung Kailangan Mo Ako, and Maging Sino Ka Man. Page reports 14,405,223 views and the channel is shown as verified.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.004 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 5 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: Mahal Kita, Remember Me — Renz Verano Medley
entries.evidence: Public channel popularity snapshot lists approximately 6.45M views. Exact publication date and section list were not captured from the video page; competing ConesStudio Renz Verano version is also under review.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.007 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 5 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: Freddie Aguilar Nonstop Medley
entries.evidence: Public YouTube description timestamps eight sections: Anak, Sa Kuko Ng Agila, Kumusta Ka, Magdalena, Minamahal Kita, Himig, Magbako Ka, and Mindanao. It overlaps three songs in KantaCue's existing shorter Freddie Aguilar medley, but adds five sections and has a materially longer experience.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.006 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 5 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: OPM Medley Karaoke
entries.evidence: Previously discovered public YouTube candidate. Public view/date and track-list evidence were not captured in this research pass; investigate cautiously.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.002 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 5 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: Best of '80s & '90s Music in Karaoke with Lyrics
entries.evidence: Public YouTube description labels this a one-hour karaoke medley and lists 11 song/time entries spanning Wham, Air Supply, Celine Dion, Bonnie Tyler, Aerosmith, Toni Basil, The Romantics, No Doubt, Poison, Rick James, and CCR. Exact total runtime and continuity are not independently confirmed.

entries.title: Best Karaoke with Lyrics Dance Hits '80s
entries.evidence: Public YouTube result lists a karaoke medley with Whitney Houston, Pat Benatar, Cyndi Lauper, The Romantics, and David Bowie; view count is 17,194.

entries.title: Mega Hits: Best Female Karaoke with Lyrics
entries.evidence: Public official-channel result describes a multi-artist female karaoke hits mix. Exact track list, date, and view count were not captured.

entries.title: Best of Bon Jovi: Karaoke with Lyrics
entries.evidence: Public YouTube description lists You Give Love a Bad Name, Wanted Dead or Alive, Livin' on a Prayer, I'll Be There for You, and It's My Life; 11,934 public views reported.

entries.title: Queen: Best Songs in Karaoke
entries.evidence: Public YouTube description lists Another One Bites the Dust, Crazy Little Thing Called Love, Somebody to Love, Under Pressure, Don't Stop Me Now, and Radio Ga-Ga; 10,232 public views reported.

entries.title: Bon Jovi Medley Karaoke
entries.evidence: Public YouTube page labels it a Bon Jovi medley karaoke and reports 1,016,985 views. Track list and arrangement details were not captured; competing Stingray Bon Jovi candidate has an explicit list but far fewer views.

entries.title: Taylor Swift Medley Karaoke
entries.evidence: Public YouTube page labels it a Taylor Swift karaoke medley and reports 114,150 views. The channel description is sparse and song list/presentation are unknown.

entries.title: 1 Hour Non Stop Club Hits Karaoke with Lyrics
entries.evidence: Public YouTube description lists 15 hip-hop, rap, dance, and pop selections; public result reports 14,729 views. Some track identity/style details and continuity remain unreviewed.

runtime.environment: Playwright Chromium through KantaCue's real audit page/controller
